## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Inner Biographies of the Immortal Perfected at the Zhōngnán Ancestral Seat*

by [李道謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E9%81%93%E8%AC%99) (Lǐ Dàoqiān, 1219–1296) — Quán zhēn historian

A major **Yuán Quán zhēn hagiography** covering the immortals and perfected associated with **Zhōng nán shān** 終南山, the ancestral seat (*zǔ tíng* 祖庭) of the **Quán zhēn 全眞** lineage. With [KR5c0356](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0356) and the *Gān shuǐ xiān yuán lù* 甘水仙源錄, it is one of the cornerstone primary sources for the history of the Quán zhēn school and its early hierarchs. Dated by preface 1284. Preserved as **DZ 955** / CT 955 (*Dòngshén bù, Jì chuán lèi* 洞神部記傳類) in 3 *juàn*.

**Dating.** 1284 (preface). Dynasty: 元.
